notes.title: Upcoming Update - Patchnotes
notes.content:
Today we have already the patchnotes for the upcoming update ready for you :) 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28135608/40d1c10630c697de29c9bfba964432dfb860352c.jpg

🇬🇧 upcoming patch
🆕️ Most important changes/new features
• Limitation of the load, in addition to weight, also by base area
• Refuelling system added at various locations in the game world (fuel truck and trailer)
• AI employees now incur fuel costs
• Weekly salaries for AI employees added incl. display of payment in the on-screen navigation system
• Added transport of cows
• Trailers are now stored in the 5 parking spaces in the shelter at the company headquarters
• Start/destination selection now possible in the route planning window
• Added fuel trucks and trailers
• Adjustable vibration function for controller activated (reaction to engine, accidents and kerbs)
• Savegame storage via steamcloud
🚚 Gameplay
• Speed display in the on-screen sat nav is updated in longer cycles
• Nearby trucks/trailers combined on one symbol in the world map (incl. separate listing)
• Adjustment of sales proceeds for trucks and trailers (residual value lower than new price)
• Balancing of economy values (purchase prices, remuneration, salaries, etc.) 
⚙️ Optimizations
• Optimized performance in the paint designer and in the world map
• Default bindings for steering wheel and controller templates
• Special bindings for Xbox 360, XB1, PS4 and PS5 controllers
• Removed unnecessary animation controllers and rigs for vehicles
• Trigger colour at gas stations and loading/unloading points changed for better recognition
🖱 Menu navigation
• Menu for key assignment translated into other languages
• Adaptation of the UI for employee list
• Assignment of employees to vehicles corrected
• Display of maximum loading area in trucks/trailer statistics
• By clicking on the position of the driver in the world map, it now moves correctly
• Rocco Schädel profile picture changed
• Splashscreens updated + logos replaced + Toxtronyx changed to tox2 in the credits
• Credits updated
• Various translations added (e.g. in menus and notifications)
• Icons in the shop and logistics menu updated
📊 Physics
• Loading values are more realistic (incl. cattle transport) 
• Expansion of transmission features (total weight of truck/trailer now influences the behaviour of the transmission shifting) 
• Improved driving physics with regard to loading
👾 Bug fixes
• Error when purchasing a new vehicle, in connection with the message "Please pick up the purchased motor vehicle first", although there is no vehicle at the position, has been fixed
• Bug in tutorial display corrected (when trailer placed in game world)
• More than 3 buttons in the logistics menu for employees (9 slots available)
• Driver display at the bottom right can also be switched through for trucks that were not active when the savegame was loaded
• (unintentional) overwriting of a profile with the same name no longer possible
• Destination "gas station" is removed from the order list as soon as the distance falls below a certain level 
• MouseOver for accepted order jumps to the position of the gas station on the world map
• Petrol station symbol is displayed in the list of accepted order
• Corrected up/down rotation of the orbit camera
• No more penalty for cancelling an order if goods have not yet been loaded 
• Route planning: incorrect display of the company name corrected 
• On screen navi is displayed when changing to animal transporter
• Graphics option "Texture filtering" can also be changed with keyboard and controller
• No negative load values for AI employees
• Path calculations corrected 
• Error when cancelling orders for AI employees corrected
• Corrected: Non-functioning light on trailer after resetting the vehicle (tail light, indicator and brake light) 
• Bug fix: Tablet cannot be closed after assigning an employee to a missing truck
• On-screen sat nav now remains permanently switched off if this has been deactivated via the action menu (but briefly appears when orders are completed, in the event of accidents, salary payments and speed cameras) 
• Path calculation near Rostock corrected 
• Corrected path calculation to gas station in Leipzig
• Terrain sections in Nuremberg corrected
• Added missing traffic lights in cities 
• Reduced clustering of AI vehicles
• Fixed parked vehicles at various points in the game world
• Missing collision detection at Pet Shop Company Stuttgart corrected
• TomOil Hamburg can now be approached
• Incorrect English translation of Kassel corrected
• Incorrectly positioned delineators corrected
• Fixed wrong mesh file for TGX XXL cabin in the shop
• Deleted double windscreen wipers for the ingame shop models
• Incorrect centre of gravity calculation for trucks with semi-trailers after loading a savegame corrected
🎮Console-specific (PS5, XBox Series X|S, PS4, Xbox One)
- Bloom effect disabled on consoles
- Trophies bug fixed (PS5)
- Fixed display errors with water and fences (PS4, Xbox One)
- Controller settings are now saved when exiting the game
- Fixed a game crash in connection with the Ferrari Thrustmaster 458 steering wheel (Xbox)
- Fixed a bug when navigating with the D-Pad in the main menu (Xbox One)

notes.title: On the Road Update Version 0.6.2 2017-07-25
notes.content:
The new On the Road update to version 0.6.2 lays the foundation for the upcoming economy system – you can now purchase more trucks for your vehicle fleet. Additionally the update includes functional petrol stations allowing you to refuel your trucks. Furthermore, there are noticeable improvements to the AI traffic, textures, vehicle physics, and more aspects of the game. As usual, the update will be downloaded and installed automatically via Steam.

Main Features:
Working Petrolstations and fueling 
Removed invisible barriers for the driver
Hop off wherever you want
Italian localisation

Features:
New input manager for 3 different devices at once plus keyboard settings
Force Feedback management expanded to three devices
Controller menu auto adjusts known devices (List of known devices will be expanded in near future)
Deadzone sliders moved to input menu for each function that is assigned to an axis
Semitruck+trailer added
Standard truck is now without rigid trailer
Rigid trailer and semi truck can be bought within the vehicles menu (WIP) 
New vegetation system added with shadow casting billboards and rotateable trees
New Decal system added (massive dirt, grafiti, asphalt patches) for testing added to Kiel
Mirrors refresh every frame now but only when they are visible (warning! Better hardware needed for ultra wide screen)
Improved light and reflection setup 
Started adding different road and sidewalk materials
Rigid trailer materials reworked (WIP) and trailer length increased
TGX front bumper and headlights reworked
Many new and reworked textures mainly on roads and sidewalks
Lanterns reworked
Improved water materials
Chinese loca simplified and traditional (community based)
Slovak loca (community based)
G27/G29 shift LEDs flash red at shiftpoint or at speeding more than 90kph

Fixes:
Complete rework of ai control triggers
Complete rework of ai collision avoidance
Fixed a bug in the collider structure causing left turning ai vehicles to ignore the player
Massively stabilized ai, reduced CPU load of ai and increased number of spawned vehicles
Fixed a number in the differential lock settings causing a power transfer of 1000% instead of 10% causing the truck to drift
Removed occassional CPU spikes caused by unused light features of Unity
Removed sun from the reflection to remove the ugly spots on reflective surfaces
Decreased rain sound volume in cockpit

Known issues
No warning when on low fuel
Unwanted gearshift when climbing back into the cabin
AI ignores player truck after leaving the cabin
